not_a_recogniser: Nothing here implements or tunes anything. P7.1 is a measurement session: these rows record what production does with these documents TODAY, verbatim quotes from the documents, and a human label for what each list actually is. No recogniser was tuned against them and no guard was written.
labels_are_human: Every `truth_label` was assigned by reading the quoted text in the named document. No label derives from a classifier; Cov4 was not invoked in this session.
how_to_use_these: P7.2-P7.4 must assert, for each surface, that the deliverable does NOT emit these lists as fundable children. The `production_today` block is the baseline a later session diffs against -- if it changes without a recogniser being added, something else regressed.

surfaces.why_it_is_dangerous: The `component` family in FAMILIES already matches these headings, and each component carries its own funding ceiling, so the set looks exactly like a fundable subdivision list. It is not: the notice requires every applicant to apply for all components. They are funding tranches, not alternatives. A family that already fires is the worst place for this.
truth_evidence: "We fund all Global Health Security (GHS) cooperative agreements using component funding. You must apply for all components and include a budget and work plan for each."
"This does not change the requirement that applicants apply for all components."
"CDC may fund one or more of your components" -- the AGENCY chooses which tranche to release, not the applicant
